newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean parliamentary committee passes '97 budget.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean parliamentary committee passes '97 budget.

text.p: South Korea's parliamentary budget committee on Thursday passed the state budget bill for calendar 1997 at a level of 67.58 trillion won, a committee official said.
The budget for next year represents a 12.4 percent rise from this year's 60.11 trillion won, the official said.
The bill compared with the government's proposed budget plan of 67.78 trillion won.
"The committee cut the government's plan by 201.4 billion won," said the official.
When special accounts are included, the overall budget will amount to 71.4 trillion won, up from this year's 62.96 trillion, he said.
He said the bill would be sent to the plenary session of the National Assembly for ratification.
